title: Credit Administration Standard — Equipment & Vehicle Loans Applications and Funding
content:
## 1. Application and decision

1.1 An application for an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is registered with the product's official name, the amount, the rate type and the installment frequency requested.

1.2 A credit officer decides it, and the servicing desk never approves or declines.

## 2. Limits on the amount, the unit, the term and the rate type

2.1 The amount may not exceed the product's largest original principal or fall below its smallest original principal.

2.2 The amount may not exceed the product's largest advance for a new unit, as a percentage of the purchase price of new units, or the product's largest advance for a pre-owned unit, as a percentage of the purchase price or appraised value (whichever is lower) of pre-owned units.

2.3 A unit older than the product's oldest unit age at funding, counted in years from its model year, is not financed.

2.4 The term may not exceed the product's longest term, and the frequency must be one of the product's allowed installment frequencies; a variable rate may be chosen only where the product offers a variable rate.

2.5 An EquipDirect Dealer Contract is originated only through a participating dealer, whose name is recorded.

## 3. Conditions of funding

3.1 The loan is funded only after every unit is pledged with its serial number and pledged value, proof of physical-damage insurance naming the association loss payee is received and the member holds the stock or participation certificate required under the association's borrower stock requirement.

## 4. Terms fixed on funding

4.1 On funding the first installment falls no more than the product's first-installment limit in calendar days after the funding date.

4.2 The installment is the level payment amortising the original principal over the term at the contract rate, rounded up to the cent.

4.3 A loan fee of the product's loan fee percentage of original principal, bounded by the product's minimum and maximum loan fee, is assessed; a product whose loan fee bounds are both zero books no loan fee row.

4.4 Each unit pledged carries the product's lien filing fee.

## The loan fee as a figure

The loan fee is the original principal multiplied by the product's loan fee percentage and divided by 100, rounded to cents; where that figure is below the product's minimum loan fee the minimum is charged, and where it is above the product's maximum loan fee the maximum is charged.

| Hypothetical original principal on a Used Equipment Loan (0.5 %, minimum 200, maximum 1500) | Percentage figure | Loan fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| 30000.00 | 150.00 | 200.00 (minimum) |
| 120000.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 |
| 400000.00 | 2000.00 | 1500.00 (maximum) |

On an EquipDirect Dealer Contract, whose minimum and maximum loan fee are both zero, no loan fee is booked at all.

## Points of judgement

- **Pre-owned unit valued below its price.** Hypothetical: a pre-owned unit bought for 100000 and appraised at 90000 on a Used Equipment Loan (75 %) is measured against the lower figure, 90000, so the amount may not exceed 67500.
- **Funding conditions are cumulative.** All three — every unit pledged with serial number and pledged value, proof of physical-damage insurance naming the association loss payee, and the required stock or participation certificate — must be in place before funding.
- **Who decides.** The servicing desk registers the application; the decision belongs to a credit officer.
